01

About

Give me a keyword report and a blank content calendar, and I'll have opinions about both within the hour. I'm a content and brand strategist working at the intersection of SEO, social strategy, and brand communication — four years moving between agency and in-house seats, close enough to strategy to set the direction and close enough to execution to write the caption myself.

At Yirifi.ai, a Singapore-based team, I worked fully remote — scaling LinkedIn audience by 300% through keyword-informed content strategy and SERP-driven editorial planning, and engineering AI-powered workflow automation to keep output moving across time zones without a daily hand-holding call. It's the kind of role that rewards being self-directed, and I was. At Pixel Creatives, I directed omnichannel marketing for 25+ brands as Content and Communication Lead, after managing 10+ brand accounts as Social Media Executive. Earlier, at Dynamic Technosoft, I ran brand messaging end to end — testimonials, tutorials, and lead-generation campaigns included.

I'm most useful in the gap between strategy and execution — the person who sets the content calendar and still knows why a post isn't landing.

I hold a BBA in Marketing from Westcliff University, and I'm currently looking for my next remote role as a Social Media Content Strategist or Digital Marketing Account Manager.
